introduction: Michigan 211 offers free, confidential referrals to community assistance. Phone support operates 24 hours a day, every day.
description: Michigan 211 offers free, confidential referrals to community assistance. Phone support operates 24 hours a day, every day.

sections.who: Anyone seeking local Michigan resources can use the service. Referred organizations set their own eligibility conditions.
sections.get: Navigators connect people with food, housing, utility, transport and other services. Assistance funding is decided by providers.

sections.apply:
1. Call or text

    Dial 211 or 844-875-9211, or text your ZIP code to 898211.

  2. Explain the problem

    Ask for providers accepting applications now.

  3. Follow up

    Search Michigan 211 or contact the referred provider and confirm intake requirements.
sections.after: Request another referral if the first cannot help; save contact details.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Michigan 211 contact and services. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
